purpose: The wave-code vocabulary M49.G1 enforces over validation/m49/ledger.json. It lives here, as data, because the ledger is an append-only record written by whichever agent closes a review wave: a vocabulary hardcoded inside the gate drifts the moment a wave appends a legitimate code, and the drift shows up as G1 failing on a row no rule forbade (CPP1/RS1/GO1/CS1/Z1 at W13; RB1 at W14). The gate keeps its full strictness — a code outside this registry still fails — and now additionally requires every reviews/ language directory to either own a code or be listed under `unwaved` with a reason, so the next wave must register itself instead of tripping an invisible list.

unwaved.convergence: Cross-language convergence sweep (M49.CONV) — its findings land as waves, not as a per-language ledger row.
unwaved.java: Java's review waves are registered in script/m14/spec/java-completeness.json (JD codes) plus the onboarding board; the M49 ledger carries no java row, because J2/J4/J5/J6 are JAVASCRIPT (J = javascript above). Recorded here rather than left silent, so the gap is visible in the gate output.
unwaved.svelte: Svelte's waves (Sv1/Sv2, M49.W4) close through the web-family folder; no per-language M49 ledger row exists.
unwaved.systems-family: Family-level roll-up (closure report + onboarding rows), not a per-language wave.
unwaved.web-family: Family-level roll-up (closure report + onboarding rows), not a per-language wave.
unwaved.tools: Tooling and surface reviews (not a language): their findings land as waves or as proposals, and no per-language M49 ledger code is allocated.
unwaved.migrate: Feature review of the migrate tool (not a language): recorded in its own review folder and the onboarding board; no per-language ledger code.
unwaved.merge: Repository-merge review (a process record, not a language): its waves are the merge commits themselves; no per-language ledger code.
unwaved.functional-family: Family-level roll-up across the functional languages: a closure report plus onboarding rows, not a per-language wave, matching systems-family and web-family above.
unwaved.health: Feature review of the health tool (not a language): recorded in its own review folder and the onboarding board; no per-language ledger code.

nonWaveCodes.CLJ: MULTI-WAVE SUMMARY row, not a wave: it records the Clojure analyzer waves as CLOSED as a group (CLJ1 + deep review + #881 + CLJ-ADV). Renumbering it to CLJ1 would make a summary read as wave 1, which is false.
nonWaveCodes.ELX: MULTI-WAVE SUMMARY row, not a wave: it records the Elixir waves as CLOSED as a group (EX2 + EX3 + EX-F5 + EX-ADV + F4/F8/M12). Renumbering it to ELX1 would make a summary read as wave 1, which is false.
nonWaveCodes.BEAM-MR: CROSS-LANGUAGE MASTER-REVIEW pass, not a wave: the java/groovy master-review formula applied across the BEAM family (clojure + elixir). It has no single language to own it, so no wave number can be correct.
